positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
+Developed Authentication and Authorization applications for Amazon Connect, a cloud Contact Service Center
+Designed and developed public AWS APIs using API Gateway and Lambda. (  https://docs.aws.amazon.com/connect/latest/APIReference/API_ListSecurityProfiles.html)
+Created an automation framework tool that helps greatly for Regional Expansion and Ops. Reduce effort for setting up a new region from 1 month of dev to 2 weeks of dev.
+Important skills such as CDK, Java, AWS cloudformation, DynamoDb, AWS Cloudwatch, Lambda, ECS Fargate, API Gateway, Typescript, Tessting Automation framework, etc

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Conducted in-depth internal data analysis to suggest a product offering that optimizes search engine for internal use.
•	Developed a fully-functioning, AI-powered chatbot that provides internal information and tools.
•	The project helped corporate save $1M/ year in employee working hours and was presented to CTO and EVPs of the company.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer Co-op
positions.description:
•	Developed C/C++, embedded software solutions in a real-time and multicore system environment. 
•	Designed, implemented, and tested software that communicates to other parts of the product or system via APIs or services.
•	Automated build with Jenkins CI/CD pipeline for measuring and improving computing performance to address business needs.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with teammates in constructing a force sensitive equipment for determining cellular tumors.
•	Hands on experience with Arduino switchboard by utilizing circuitry to construct a force sensitive equipment.  
•	Implemented SolidWorks to make fake tumor cells and create GCode on a FlashForge Finder 3D Printer.

projects.title: Jerome, Machine Learning and Big Data Organization, sponsored by Chevron
projects.description:
•	Designing a cloud-based software system that automatically intelligently organizes and classifies big data. 
•	Applying text analytics, image processing and different machine learning techniques for finding and inferring relationships between both data files and classes of data.

projects.title: Texas A&M Faculty Progress Report Web Application
projects.description:
• Designed a web application based on Model-View-Controller (MVC) architecture for faculty data management using Ruby on Rails framework. 
• Developed a solution for extracting quantitative data from Faculty Progress Reports in Excel/PDF, computing metrics for department score card. 
• Created comprehensive test cases to validate system features and ensured code quality
